artworks.name: 寒霜之祠
artworks.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Task: Substantially refine Image 1, the Frost Shrine game sprite, in response to art direction that it must instantly read as a trophy structure crafted from Frostjaw (大霜鲨 / sharkboi), the Don't Starve Together boss. Preserve its role as a compact usable shrine with a dark front offering alcove and a small icy core, its centered 3/4-overhead in-game view, and the hand-drawn style. Preserve genuine transparent background. Change the source identity of the architecture.
Inputs: Image 1 is the edit target, our previous shrine design. Image 2 is the actual full-front Frostjaw, a CHARACTER IDENTITY reference only. Image 3 is the original Frostjaw sprite atlas, a MATERIAL AND SHAPE reference only. Do not output an atlas or a character reference sheet.
Critical art direction: Integrate Frostjaw's real signature anatomy into a believable trophy building, as the game's Scaled Furnace integrates Dragonfly parts. The previous generic stone scales and forked chimney must be redesigned. The identity cues must form the architecture itself.
Design:
1. Squat, broad, blunt shark muzzle silhouette forms the shrine's front facade in pale ash-grey hide/bone-like stone, not dragon scales. Above the opening is a heavy broad angular brow with two subtle X-shaped worn scar marks, echoing the boss's forehead. Use small unlit inset eye slits as architectural relief, not cartoon eyes.
2. The unmistakable Frostjaw ICE JAW is the central signature: a blue-grey crystalline U-shaped lower jaw with large flame/leaf-shaped pointed ice blades sweeping UPWARD, pale white facet borders and a long central downward chin point, like the boss's actual jaw in Image 2. This jaw frames the LOWER and SIDE edges of the dark shrine opening, like a trophy mandible held open. A few bone-white triangular shark teeth on the top lintel complete an open mouth entrance. Do not obstruct the alcove or its visible cyan core.
3. A broad collar/mantle of shaggy off-white Frostjaw mane wraps the upper body and falls at the sides. Use broken tapered fur tufts and grey ink hatching, closely matching the reference. White FUR, distinguishable from snow. Limit the white mass to roughly a quarter of the whole so the architecture stays readable.
4. ONE tall narrow backward-swept icy dorsal fin rises from the top-center, blue-grey with white angular facets, matching the curved blade on the boss's forehead. Two short grey cheek/side fins support the silhouette; no antlers and no forked chimney.
5. Two short grey clawed fin supports at the lower sides, integrated into a low rough oval masonry plinth. A few simple stone joints at the base establish a constructed structure. No giant floor diorama.
The alcove holds a small irregular icy nucleus nested in an upward-pointing crystalline jaw fragment; make it a small light-blue accent, not an obvious heart symbol. Recognizable from far away by the swept ice fin, white mane, broad grey muzzle and blue ICE-JAW fan.
Style: exactly Don't Starve Together hand-drawn cut-paper 2D sprite. Thick imperfect charcoal outer ink contours, thin sharp pen hatching, flat desaturated color blocks with 2-3 hard shadow values, sparse gouache grain. Match the original sprite material economy. No smooth 3D shading, no photorealism, no neon bloom. Clear at 128px.
Composition: one complete building, frontal view with a modest top plane visible, 78% of a square transparent canvas, enough padding all around, whole support base visible. Similar bulk/size language to Scaled Furnace. This is an in-world static asset approval preview.
Avoid: living complete boss, arms or legs in an attacking pose, blood, gore, skull-and-antler generic Viking altar, dragon scales, generic crystalline castle, industrial machinery, text, labels, multiple designs, checkerboard, background or external cast shadow.

artworks.name: 霜冻核心
artworks.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Task: Refine Image 1, our Frost Core inventory sprite, so it is visibly a trophy component originating from Frostjaw (大霜鲨 / sharkboi) from Don't Starve Together. Keep it one palm-sized loose magical freezing material, roughly oval compact form, bold in-game inked style, and genuinely transparent background.
Inputs: Image 1 is the edit target, our first Frost Core. Image 2 is the actual full-front Frostjaw and provides the SPECIFIC boss identity. Image 3 is its original sprite atlas for ice jaw, grey hide and off-white shaggy mane textures. These references are not extra objects to show.
Change the generic slate-rock shell into the boss's instantly recognizable frozen JAW motif: a compact U-shaped fragment of ash-grey shark jaw/cartilage, ringed by five to seven broad blue-grey icy spikes which curve upward like the crystal-beard blades in the reference, each with pale chalk-white facet edges. Keep an elegant short point at the bottom of the crystalline jaw, matching the boss's chin. The broken jaw cups and frames an irregular oval frozen nucleus at the center, with a bright cold white angular fracture deep within it, not a literal heart pictogram. The nucleus has one short backward-swept blade peak echoing Frostjaw's icy dorsal fin. Add a SMALL tufted off-white mane collar tucked around the lower rear and sides of the jaw fragment, with sparse black hatching: it must read as Frostjaw's shaggy fur, not fluffy snow or a furry creature. Two little grey triangular tooth stubs can attach to the rim. This is an inert compact trophy core, not a tiny boss head: no face, no eyes, no limbs, no stand, no necklace loop, no metal braces.
Material balance: blue-grey ice is dominant, subdued ash-grey organic jaw on the lower rim, a small off-white shaggy accent, dark charcoal gaps behind the core. Fewer larger facets for clear 64px icon readability. Distinctive jagged upward ice-jaw silhouette rather than a generic gem in a rock.
Style: Don't Starve Together inventory art, imperfect bold charcoal contour, scratchy short ink hatching, restrained flat gouache areas, 2-3 angular shadow tones, icy highlights in narrow sharp strokes. Simplify compared to fantasy RPG loot painting. No neon glow or airbrush shading.
Composition: one complete centered object on square transparent canvas, 72% canvas height, 3/4 inventory view, no cast shadow or floor; consistent size and overall contrast with Image 1.
Avoid: realistic internal organs, blood, gore, red or gold metal, snowflakes, magic circles, hanging ornament, antlers, butterfly wings, generic spiky crown around a perfect sphere, sci-fi device, glossy 3D, text, label, extra objects, image panels, checkerboard.
